test.command: env -u FORCE_COLOR NO_COLOR=1 uv run pytest tests/unfinished --deselect tests/unfinished/test_unfinished_e2e.py::test_the_own_sessions_read_lists_only_its_own_branches_at_this_hosts_scale --no-cov -n 4 --dist loadgroup

test-host.command: rm -rf .telemetry/unfinished/test-host && env -u FORCE_COLOR BUDGET_TELEMETRY_DIR=.telemetry/unfinished/test-host NO_COLOR=1 uv run pytest tests/unfinished/test_unfinished_e2e.py::test_the_own_sessions_read_lists_only_its_own_branches_at_this_hosts_scale --no-cov -n 4 --dist loadgroup

budgets-host.//: llmlint: ignore[expensive_tests_stay_behind_their_own_edge] The task labels own-sessions-read-seconds host and forbids a cache-restored wall clock, and just check runs every host budget whatever the diff, so the fresh measurement this edge pulls in (the test-host scale journey, about 30 seconds) runs on every check. A drafted follow-up decides whether host budgets join the diff selection, which would put this journey behind the project's own edge and delete this directive.
